mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or interaction signal Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 110, strong supply growth signals robust economic activity that supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO exceeds 110, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 2.5% for three consecutive months signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a severe economic slowdown that triggers a risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline for two consecutive quarters, or interaction signal Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), rising interest rates compress equity valuations by increasing the discount rate, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.
